template.name: Parabolic SAR Bug5
template.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so a price/EMA(10) crossing stands in for the documented price crossing the SAR, with an above-average volume confirmation on the documented 20-period baseline; the opposite cross with confirmation is the exit. Step, Maximum, StopLossPoints, TakeProfitPoints, TrailPoints, Reverse and SarClose are acceleration, point and boolean fields.
